request.subject: IMPROVEMENT:SAWMILL

layers.text: Remove all ground: erase the brown wooden deck and the round wheels under the shed, so the posts, the saw blade and the logs stand directly on a transparent background with nothing at all under them. Repaint any brown wood in pale straw-yellow birch. Keep the red tile roof, the big steel circular saw blade with its teeth, the stack of pale logs, outline and art style exactly the same.
